name: Invariant Subspace Linear Dependency
description: Translates the requirement of graph connectivity (spanning differences) into a linear algebraic condition on the invariant subspace of a set of averaging operators. The condition $\sum x_{c_i} = t \cdot x_{c_1}$ must hold for all invariant states, which mathematically forces all targets to belong to the same connected component. This defeats models by forcing them to deduce the component-equality requirement from a sum identity, breaking their immediate heuristic mapping from $m=n-1$ to a tree-pruning algorithm.
